leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize authentication state with React hooks to manage user login status
Configure event listeners to detect browser tab visibility changes
Implement a synchronization mechanism that updates auth state across multiple tabs
Construct a custom hook that centralizes multi-tab auth logic
Integrate localStorage with React state to persist authentication data
Render conditional UI components based on synchronized auth status
Manipulate browser storage events to trigger state updates in other tabs
